name: Extra Deed
body:
You have honed your deadly skills and gained more deeds to your name.

Prerequisite: Wanderer 1st level

Benefit: You gain one additional wanderer deed. You must meet all the prerequisites for this deed.

Special: You can gain Extra Deed multiple times.
